1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Record all demo reels. Requires fiz binary and asciinema.
3	# Usage: ./demos/record.sh [--lmstudio URL]
4	#
5	# By default uses FIZEAU_BASE_URL from env or http://localhost:1234/v1.
6	# Session logs are saved to demos/sessions/ for CI replay.
7	set -euo pipefail
8	
9	cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
10	
11	# Ensure fiz is built
12	make build
13	
14	LMSTUDIO_URL="${FIZEAU_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:1234/v1}"
15	MODEL="${FIZEAU_MODEL:-qwen/qwen3-coder-next}"
16	
17	export FIZEAU_BASE_URL="$LMSTUDIO_URL"
18	export FIZEAU_MODEL="$MODEL"
19	
20	echo "Recording demos against $LMSTUDIO_URL with model $MODEL"
21	
22	for script in demos/scripts/demo-*.sh; do
23	  name=$(basename "$script" .sh | sed 's/demo-//')
24	  cast="website/static/demos/${name}.cast"
25	  echo "Recording: $name -> $cast"
26	  asciinema rec "$cast" \
27	    --cols 100 --rows 30 \
28	    --title "Fizeau: $name" \
29	    --command "bash $script" \
30	    --overwrite
31	done
32	
33	# Copy session logs for CI replay
34	echo "Copying session logs..."
35	mkdir -p demos/sessions
36	latest_sessions=$(ls -t .agent/sessions/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -3)
37	i=0
38	for session in $latest_sessions; do
39	  cp "$session" "demos/sessions/"
40	  echo "  $session -> demos/sessions/"
41	done
42	
43	echo "Done. Cast files in website/static/demos/, sessions in demos/sessions/"
44

# Fizeau

Embeddable Go agent runtime - local-model-first via LM Studio.

[![CI](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Release](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/releases/latest/badge.svg)](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/releases/latest)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Fizeau is a Go library that implements a coding agent runtime - a tool-calling
LLM loop with file read/write, shell execution, navigation helpers, and
structured I/O. Designed to be embedded in
[DDx](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/ddx) and other build orchestrators.
Prioritizes local model inference via LM Studio and Ollama, with transparent
escalation to cloud providers.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/master/install.sh | bash
```

Or with Go:

```bash
go install github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/cmd/fiz@latest
```

## Quick Start

Start [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai/) with a model that supports tool
calling (Qwen 3.5+, Llama 3.2+), then:

```bash
fiz -p "Read main.go and tell me the package name"
```

Fizeau connects to `localhost:1234` by default.

### With Anthropic

```bash
export FIZEAU_PROVIDER=anthropic
export FIZEAU_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
export FIZEAU_MODEL=claude-sonnet-4-20250514
fiz -p "Read main.go and tell me the package name"
```

29	    --command "bash $script" \

39	  cp "$session" "demos/sessions/"
